traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Haemodoraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior, half inferior or inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary, in panicles, in cymes or in racemes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit usually capsule, rarely nut; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 3 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
